Mineral guidance, controls and escape teaching - 2026-10-29
#167 submitted by Kittingsl; other items are explicit owner enhancements.
IN PROGRESS awaiting human confirmation. No issues closed.

Accepted appearance: user selected sparse fire pixels along the path. This
supersedes previous twinkle clusters/timing. Copper uses its existing torch
palette (white/teal); strontium uses red. One staggered emitter per visible
route tile, low density (1.54 pixels/sec/tile versus torch28/sec at its source),
short .6-1.1s lives, gently rising and shrinking native pixels. World-space birth
positions/velocities never track the player or the updated route. Old pixels
finish naturally after re-routing. At most128 live particles; the registry shape
is versioned so old cluster resources are safely replaced once during HMR.

Route is the full shortest walkable path, not a 12-tile prefix. Copper targets
the visual Beacon stand. Strontium uses a cached multi-source BFS from remaining
resin, so the guide leads to nearest REACHABLE resin by walking distance. Plants
are ignored; missing/unreachable resin is graceful. Changing mineral or resin
sources rebuilds the route even while standing still. No gameplay RNG draws;
no new State keys. All guide rendering preserves State, clips LOS/foreground
walls, scales density by quality, and clears when the flame ends or escape starts.

Sodium burnMul2 ->1; light, attraction, parry properties unchanged. Help no
longer claims faster burn and describes resin guidance. The normal-torch row
has no mineral-column circle (flame image remains).

Host change is specifically for the new wheel input. Native wheel is accumulated
and normalised (pixels, lines and pages); partial trackpad deltas accumulate.
Down selects right / up left; modulo wrap includes empty slots. Selecting never
spends/equips a mineral. Number keys still work and have priority. One-shot input
is consumed once per fixed step; blur clears wheel state; menu/escape scroll is
ignored. Non-passive canvas listener is removed with the existing HMR cleanup.

Escape message: exact text Spacebar to dodge. Plain dim non-bold text, no panel,
matching the pre-Beacon hotkey hint. Initially16px under RUN!/Reach the entrance;
after2s it smoothly moves down and shrinks over .8s to12px at hotbarHint. It
remains for the escape and freezes with the director timer while paused.

Verification:
- Full npm run check passes; final npm run build passes (existing large-bundle
  and static/dynamic stream-import warnings only). No dependencies added.
- New DOM-free mineral-guidance check: wall-detour resin is rejected in favour
  of walking-nearest resin; unreachable resin/plant ignored; removing resin
  re-routes a stationary player; no-resin state; mode switch; full route beyond
  twelve tiles; no RNG draws; escape gating.
- Fire check: staggered emission, bounded density/history, frozen-clock no new
  spawns, retained world coordinates through route changes, material/run reset,
  extinguish, cap128. Existing real-cave Beacon route/gating tests retained.
- Sodium burn check compares actual consumption to the plain flame rate. The
  economy scenario now uses normal burn with extra shade pressure (old faster-
  burn scenario superseded by the user's balance request).
- Intent check: both wheel directions, multi-step wrap and empty selection,
  selection-only semantics, number-key priority. Tip pose across3 viewports.
- Actual browser native wheel100/-100/1000 and50+50 deltas, pause ignore/resume,
  keyboard selection all pass. Main-host HMR keeps one canvas, one wheel action
  per notch, and selection; gameplay HMR keeps live fire registry/history.
- Browser guide fixture: average10.405 / maximum15 drawn fire pixels over121
  frames; particles retain born world positions/velocities across player/camera
  movement and route update. Frozen clock pixels identical, no State writes,
  old-cluster resource upgraded, wall clipping/flame-out and red resin target pass.
- Browser Help draw verifies no normal mineral-column arc and no faster-burn
  claim, resin guidance present. Screenshots inspected for legibility/overlap.
- Escape tip draw records16px at y299,14px at y504 during transition,12px at y709

- Browser consoles: zero errors/warnings.
